name: Fuzzing and Malicious Extension Harness
description: Fuzz the extension API surface with malformed inputs, boundary values, and concurrent access patterns. Test with deliberately malicious extensions that attempt escape, privilege escalation, and resource exhaustion. Prove isolation holds.
purpose: Validate that all security boundaries hold under adversarial conditions by fuzzing the extension API surface and testing with deliberately malicious extensions.
acceptanceCriteria: Extension API surface is identified and documented
Fuzzing harness generates malformed inputs for every API endpoint
Malicious extension test suite covers: escape attempts, privilege escalation, resource exhaustion, information disclosure
Tests prove sandbox isolation holds under attack
Tests prove IPC schema validation rejects malformed messages
Tests prove capability broker makes correct allow/deny decisions
All tests pass with no undetected violations
